title: Soup enables cheap AI fine-tuning on low-VRAM GPUs with #SoupAI #AIFinetuning #MachineLearning
description: Alpamys Makajan developed Soup, a tool that enables fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) on affordable laptop GPUs with as little as 3.3 GB of VRAM. Soup simplifies the complex process of training LLMs by using a single YAML configuration file and one command, eliminating the need for expensive cloud rentals or custom scripts. Soup’s key innovation is as-layer streaming, which loads and trains one model layer at a time, drastically reducing hardware requirements without sacrificing speed. This breakthrough makes accessible AI customization on consumer-grade laptops, empowering developers and researchers who lacked resources before. The open-source project gained viral attention on Hacker News for democratizing LLM fine-tuning and accelerating AI development at the edge, signaling a pivotal shift towards more inclusive AI innovation.
